wrong-company CIK repair (backlog listing-identity-normalization, promoted 2026-08-31): fetch.py cik_for() used to strip the exchange suffix and match the stub against SEC's US ticker table, so these nine suffixed listings adopted an unrelated US filer's CIK (ENR.DE=Energizer, BA.L=Boeing, DIS.MI=Disney, SU.PA=Suncor, AI.PA=C3.ai, ALV.DE=Autoliv, MOH.AT=Molina, NXT.AX=Nextracker, TOP.BK=US TOP). The fix in this same push makes a dotted ticker unresolvable to a US CIK without an explicit request-row cik. A prices refresh rewrites tier and cik clean; AI.PA, ALV.DE and BA.L additionally carry the wrong company's fundamentals+quality blocks, so those three get fundamentals then quality to overwrite via the vendor leg. No profile, screen row or dive may cite any of the nine until these rows fulfill.
